Local processing · No account needed
THE QUICK HOW-TO

Small task. Sorted.

Paste one item per line. Duplicate matching is case-sensitive and ignores surrounding spaces. Choose whether to remove blank lines or sort the remaining lines. The first occurrence is kept.

Try this example

A list containing apple, pear and apple on separate lines becomes apple and pear.

Good to know

Are uppercase and lowercase the same?

No. Apple and apple are treated as separate entries.

Do I need to create an account?

No. All Toolnest tools work without an account. There are no paid features in this version.
